title: 第23章 二阶灵主第24章 八阶灵兽
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
楚少野见它不吃也没有理，从烤蜥蜴上剔了一大块肉下来，放到盘子里细细切成小块，递给金线寻宝鼠。
“吃吧，多亏雪宝找到了草药，辛苦你了。”
听到这话，小狐狸的头埋得更低了，把身体缩成小小的一团，大眼睛里盈满了泪水。
完了，它再也不是灵主最爱的灵宠了，灵主不喜欢它了。
小狐狸越想越伤心，忍不住哭了起来，但是它又不想让楚少野听到，拼命忍住，身体一抖一抖的。
楚少野看它这个可怜样，还是忍不住过去将它抱了起来。
被这么一安抚，小狐狸顿时更委屈了，终于忍不住放声大哭，“呜呜嗷嗷呜哇……”
楚少野眉头紧皱，平时听小狐狸嘤嘤嘤撒娇还觉得挺可爱的，可哭起来是真难听啊。
幸亏现在是白天，不然还以为有鬼在叫。
他捋了捋小狐狸的背，将盛肉汤的碗端了过来，“里面放了治内伤的药，快点喝了，伤很快就能好了。”
肉汤已经凉了不少，可以直接喝，小狐狸抽噎着止住哭声，低头舔了一口，舌头顿时麻了一下。
好苦，小狐狸抬头看了一下楚少野的脸色，主人现在还是冷着一张脸，它不敢撒娇提要求，老老实实的一口接一口将肉汤喝了下去。
楚少野暗暗松了一口气，终于用肉汤把小狐狸的嘴堵住了，不用再忍受魔音贯耳。
等小狐狸喝完一碗，楚少野马上又盛了一碗。
小狐狸愣住，它还以为喝一碗就行了，灵主这是要换种方式惩罚它吗？
没办法，为了让楚少野消气，小狐狸只好又将这碗吭哧吭哧地吃完了。
楚少野还想给它盛第三碗，小狐狸急忙按住他的手，示意自己吃饱了。
楚少野摸了摸它圆滚滚的肚子，确实是饱了，他将剩下的肉汤放进黑玉戒里，冷酷无情道：“剩下的晚上接着喝。”
小狐狸：……
主银，它真的知道错了！

小狐狸泪眼汪汪地扑进楚少野怀里，眼看就要再次哭出来。
楚少野伸手捏住它的嘴巴，“知道我这次为什么这么生气吗？”
小狐狸点点头。
楚少野道：“我生气，一是因为你得意忘形，忘记了我嘱咐你的话，导致受了重伤。
二是因为你轻视对手，没有严肃对待这场战斗，在战斗的时候，一丁点的失误就可能要了你的命。
三则是因为……”
小狐狸目瞪口呆，它犯了这么多的错误吗，竟然还有第三点。
“三是因为你漠视生命，那条铁皮蜥蜴已经是强弩之末，你不应该戏耍它，以它的生命取乐。”
小狐狸的大眼睛里充满迷惑，它不太理解楚少野的意思。
楚少野摸摸它的头顶，“万灵大陆上信奉弱肉强食的法则，人类会杀灵兽获取材料，灵兽也会杀人吸食精血，人会杀人，兽会杀兽，这个世界上充满了杀戮，生灵只有通过杀戮才能继续生存下去。”
小狐狸听的更迷糊了，那到底是杀还是不杀？
“但是杀戮和虐杀是不一样的，我的意思并不是让你不要杀戮，而是不要虐杀，不要为了愉悦去杀，不要享受杀戮带来的快感，不要因为猎物濒死前的痛苦而欢愉，你明白吗？”
小狐狸犹疑着点了点头，然后又飞速摇摇头。
楚少野看到它的反应笑了笑，“不明白没关系，以后我们会一起经历很多，很快你就会明白的。”
谈完后，楚少野将小狐狸收回了灵府，以灵主的灵力温养，灵宠受的伤会恢复得更快一些。
金线寻宝鼠早就把自己那份吃完了，指着烤架上的蜥蜴，意思是还要再来一份。
楚少野又给它削了一大碗肉，自己也剃了一块吃起来。
content_en:
When Chu Shaoye saw that it didn't want to eat, he ignored it. He picked off a large piece of meat from the roasted lizard, put it on a plate and cut it into small pieces, and handed it to the golden thread treasure hunter rat.
"Eat it. Thanks to Xuebao for finding the herb. Thank you for your hard work."
Hearing this, the little fox lowered his head, curled up into a small ball, and his big eyes were filled with tears.
It’s over, it’s no longer the spirit master’s favorite pet, the spirit master doesn’t like it anymore.
The little fox became more and more sad as he thought about it, and couldn't help crying, but he didn't want Chu Shaoye to hear it, so he tried his best to hold it back, and his body trembled.
Seeing how pitiful it looked, Chu Shaoye couldn't help but go over and hug it up.
After being comforted like this, the little fox suddenly felt even more aggrieved, and finally couldn't help crying loudly, "Ooooooooooooo..."
Chu Shaoye frowned. He usually thought it was cute when the little fox cooed, but it was really ugly when he cried.
Fortunately it was daytime, otherwise I would have thought a ghost was screaming.
He rubbed the little fox's back and brought the bowl of broth over. "There is medicine for internal injuries in it. Drink it quickly and the injury will be healed soon."
The broth has cooled down a lot and can be drank directly. The little fox sobbed to stop crying, lowered his head and took a lick, and his tongue suddenly became numb.
It was so painful. The little fox raised his head and looked at Chu Shaoye's face. His master still had a cold face. He didn't dare to act coquettishly and make demands. He drank the broth honestly one after another.
Chu Shaoye secretly breathed a sigh of relief and finally blocked the little fox's mouth with broth, so he no longer had to endure the demonic sound penetrating his ears.
After the little fox finished one bowl, Chu Shaoyang filled up another bowl.
The little fox was stunned. It thought that just drinking a bowl would be enough. Did the spirit master want to punish it in another way?
There was no other way. In order to calm Chu Shaoye's anger, the little fox had no choice but to finish the bowl again.
Chu Shaoye wanted to serve him a third bowl, but the little fox quickly pressed his hand to indicate that he was full.
Chu Shaoye touched its round belly and found that it was indeed full. He put the remaining broth into the black jade ring and said ruthlessly: "Drink the rest of the night."
Little Fox:......
Master Yin, he really knows that he is wrong!
The little fox threw herself into Chu Shaoye's arms with tears in her eyes, and was about to cry again.
Chu Shaoye reached out and pinched its mouth, "Do you know why I'm so angry this time?"
The little fox nodded.
Chu Shaoye said: "I'm angry first because you got carried away and forgot what I told you, resulting in serious injury.
The second is because you despise your opponent and do not take this battle seriously. During the battle, a slight mistake may cost you your life.
The third reason is because..."
The little fox was stunned. It had made so many mistakes, and there was a third one.
"The third reason is because you are indifferent to life. That iron-skinned lizard is at the end of its life. You should not play with it and take pleasure in its life."
The little fox's big eyes were full of confusion. It didn't quite understand what Chu Shaoye meant.
Chu Shaoye touched the top of its head and said, "On the Wanling Continent, we believe in the law of the weak and the strong. Humans will kill spirit beasts to obtain materials, and spirit beasts will also kill people to suck their essence and blood. People will kill people, and beasts will kill beasts. This world is full of killing, and living things can only continue to survive through killing."
The little fox became even more confused after hearing this. Should he kill him or not?
"But killing and cruelty are different. What I mean is not to tell you not to kill, but not to kill. Don't kill for pleasure. Don't enjoy the pleasure of killing. Don't take pleasure in the pain of the prey before it dies. Do you understand?"
The little fox nodded hesitantly, then shook his head quickly.
Chu Shaoye smiled when he saw its reaction, "It doesn't matter if you don't understand. We will experience a lot together in the future, and you will understand soon."
After the conversation, Chu Shaoye took the little fox back to the spirit mansion and used the spiritual power of the spirit master to warm it.If you raise it, the injuries suffered by your spiritual pet will recover faster.
The golden-threaded treasure hunter had already finished his portion and pointed at the lizard on the grill, indicating that he wanted another portion.
Chu Shaoye cut another large bowl of meat for it, and shaved off a piece himself to eat.
